observations: Industrial flatbed sewing machine with 'Brother' logo visible on machine body (photos 0, 1, 2).
Machine mounted on a table branded 'JINET' with ruler markings along the edge.
A small control box (red/blue switch) is mounted under the table near the motor area, consistent with a motor controller but type not legible.
Blue foot pedal visible, connected by a cord under the table.
Photos 1 and 2 appear to be duplicates of the same angle.
No model number, serial plate, or motor nameplate is legible in any photo.
Table and stand show normal wear; no rust or damage visible from this angle.

risks.risk: Table/stand structural integrity and 'new legs' claim

risks.if_unproven: priced as standard used stand, no premium for 'new'

risks.proof: Photo of underside of machine head and tabletop cutout

proof_requests: Video of the machine running with pedal pressed, showing stitch formation
Close-up photo of motor nameplate (to confirm servo motor brand/model)
Close-up photo of any model/serial plate on the machine head

response.reason: Item is identifiable as a Brother industrial sewing machine by brand only (no model visible), and all seller upgrade claims are unverified from photos, so it is priced at worst case as a used, unverified-condition machine pending proof of working motor and stitching.
